effect_description_eng:
[Trash] [Main] If you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, you may play this card from your trash with the play cost reduced by 4.
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait trait from your trash without paying the cost.
